parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states an action: "separate the description of the previous methods and the proposed method in section 2." This is a direct instruction, so the action is explicit. The comment also identifies the exact modification to apply—restructuring section 2 so that the previous methods and the proposed method are described separately—which tells the authors precisely what change to make and where to apply it. Under the criteria, a concrete action is one where authors know exactly what needs to be done and how to apply it; this instruction satisfies that requirement, as the authors can directly identify the modification to their draft. Therefore, the comment contains an explicit action with concrete implementation details.

change_log.original_sentence: However, it does not provide concrete details on how to implement this separation—such as whether to use bullet points, subsections, or a specific formatting style.
change_log.corrected_sentence: The comment also identifies the exact modification to apply—restructuring section 2 so that the previous methods and the proposed method are described separately—which tells the authors precisely what change to make and where to apply it.
change_log.reason: The original imposed formatting requirements (bullets, subsections) not demanded by the rubric; the instruction itself specifies the concrete modification and its location.
